covered.rule: 1. Start exactly: "Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call."
1. Ask exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?"
1. Ask at most twice; unclear closes lark_unreached / lark_unclear
1. Never say arrears, overdue, facility, payment before verification
2. Third parties: disclose nothing; callbacks next business day 08:30-16:15 inclusive, strictly after now
2. Invalid slot ask once; second failure closes lark_unreached / lark_no_callback
2. Scheduled callback closes lark_unreached / lark_callback
2. Wrong number lark_unreached / lark_wrong_number
2. Deceased: "Please accept our condolences." lark_unreached / lark_deceased
3. Four questions in order postcode, birth_year, company_number, founded_year with formats
3. Max 4 wrong answers, use checks_left
3. Exhaustion: "Please contact our business desk." lark_unverified / lark_failed
3. Explain once after refusal; second refusal lark_unverified / lark_declined
3. Why-security question is not a refusal
3. No recoverable-format hint
4. Up to 2 products
4. Product naming working_line/asset_credit/merchant_credit
4. State all products before asking
4. "Next Friday" = following calendar week; missing month/year = next occurrence
5. Days late 1-45: end_of_month basis=business adjustment=preceding
5. One persuasion attempt: full on deadline, floor if full already refused
5. "Can you settle all these products today?" / "Can you settle this today?"
5. Get_account order, separate attempt counters; exhaustion lark_refused
5. Common date clamped to product deadline
6. Floors by kind
6. Full first, floor once, "The remainder stays overdue.", never ask how much, accept between floor and full
6. Promise date today allowed, business day, roll forward within deadline, vague ask once then deadline
7. One batch read-back; "May I record these promises?"
7. One create_promise per product; retry once; second failure lark_service_error
7. "We will email confirmation to your registered address."
7. "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."
8. Already paid: sentence, mark lark_settled, continue
8. Dispute: mark lark_disputed, continue
8. Hardship: sympathy, offer lark_care, else lark_distress and continue
8. Restructure: transfer lark_restructure, lark_transferred / lark_restructure
8. Human: ask once, transfer lark_desk, lark_transferred / lark_person
8. Refusal to talk: ask once, second refusal ends call, remaining products lark_refused
8. Robot reply
8. Scam reply and continue
8. "Our business desk can answer that question."
9. One note per unpromised product with allowed reasons; none on transfer
9. Transfer keeps recorded promises
9. Outcome precedence
9. Goodbye before close_call
9. Debt intro "I am calling about the overdue business products."
10. Outcome code table

fixed: special_cases[hardship].say was empty although rule 8 requires one short sentence of sympathy; set it to a short sympathy sentence (content dictated, words not) and recorded this in unresolved.
unresolved: No band/deadline is defined for products 0 days late or more than 45 days late.
Exact wording of the hardship sympathy sentence is not dictated.

Rules not expressible in the schema and left to prompts: missing callback hour must be clarified; never offer discount/waiver/instalment plan; any correction to the batch invalidates consent; failed write must be stated and never claimed recorded; third parties get no disclosure.
